images.author: Abel Kavanagh / MONUSCO
images.why: Documented Congo-side aerial photographed between Bunia and Beni. Original listed at 5760×3840; regional view rather than summit close-up, with aircraft framing to crop out.

images.author: RobSC
images.why: Precisely identified Uganda-side view from Mount Speke, showing Margherita with Alexandra behind and Albert beside it. Strong summit-identification candidate; 2000-pixel availability unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Bright snowfield leading toward rocky peaks under blue sky, suitable for a tight vertical crop. Uganda-labelled photograph; supplied 1920-pixel version falls slightly below the preferred resolution.

images.author: Andres Smith
images.why: Documented north-face photograph from January 2024, showing the mountain's contemporary rocky appearance. Direct gallery file; dimensions unverified.

images.author: bc44caesar
images.why: Classic view from Pico Espejo, with the jagged summit and snow patches against deep blue sky. Photographed January 2008; 2000-pixel availability unverified.

images.author: Lindsay Griffin
images.why: Sunset illuminates the west face above shadowed slopes, photographed from León ridge. Historical December 1985 glacier coverage; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Lindsay Griffin
images.why: Clear blue-sky view of the massif from the Toro–León traverse. Historical December 1985 photograph with substantially more ice than today; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Robert Cassady
images.why: Directly identified view of Carstensz Pyramid's north face from peaks across the valley, emphasizing the mountain itself. Source-linked larger image; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Harry Kikstra / 7summits.com
images.why: Classic main north-face photograph, explicitly credited and identified by the publisher. Broad rock-wall composition; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Harry Kikstra / 7summits.com
images.why: Alternative vertical north-face composition, potentially better suited to a 9:10 card. Credited expedition photograph; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Marek Piwnicki
images.why: 5336×3185; France-side Mont Blanc in clear early-morning light, with cool blue tones and bright snow. Strong mountain-focused poster candidate.

images.author: Manon Ridet
images.why: 5472×3648; classic Chamonix-side mountain-and-lake reflection under clear blue sky. Reflection provides foreground interest for a near-square crop.

images.author: P.G Who
images.why: 3854×4818 portrait photograph; warm autumn foliage and snowy peaks in golden-hour light. Existing proportions require relatively little cropping.

images.author: Sylvain Mauroux
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies Mont Blanc in early-morning light from Pointe Whymper. Elevated France-side perspective; linked rendition requests 3000-pixel width.
